thread:
Alice Chen: FYI - FinServe's vendor risk team asked for: pen test report (redacted ok), latest vuln scan CSV, and a remediation timeline. They want these by EOD Fri.
Kyle Rivera: We can provide a redacted pen test + authenticated Nessus/Qualys scan export. Need to confirm scope is only our control plane & hosted model infra (no customer data). Also recommend a signed NDA/SoW before sending full artifacts.
Emma Patel: For POC notes - they also want the POC environment details and network diagram. If we offer Dedicated demo, we'll need a short diagram and an account-level contact. I can draft the network diagram.
Nate Gomez: I'll prepare the remediation timeline matrix - format: issue id, severity, status, fix ETA. We should avoid including exploit PoCs or raw creds. We'll provide CVE references and patch dates.
Alice Chen: Good. Two asks from FinServe: (1) Can they get presigned link(s) to download artifacts? (2) Can we include a short attestation that the issues listed were remediated or in progress?
Kyle Rivera: Yes to presigned links, 7-day expiry, and only via our secure S3 bucket. I'll have security ops generate links and redact IPs/hostnames. For attestation, we can provide a signed statement from security that the report is accurate as of X date; legal to approve language.
risk-bot: auto: request created RISK-456 for FinServe vendor review. Assignee: Kyle Rivera. Due: 1748290721.
Emma Patel: +1 on redaction. Also include a sanitized architecture diagram (remove internal hostnames). I'll add the POC checklist for their security team: required firewall rules, cert pinning notes, and data at rest encryption details.
Nate Gomez: Upload plan: s3://redwood-secured/finserve/RISK-456/ - I'll post presigned HTTPS links when ready. Example placeholder: https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RISK-456/pen-test-redacted.pdf (actual link will be presigned)
Alice Chen: Any blockers to getting this out by EOD Fri? We need to keep sales momentum.
Kyle Rivera: Blocker: legal needs to approve attestation wording and we must get a signed data handling addendum. I'll ping Legal now.
Emma Patel: I'll start the network diagram and sanitized POC doc; ETA tomorrow morning.
Nate Gomez: I'll compile the scan CSV and the remediation matrix today. ETA 3pm.
Alice Chen: Perfect. Once we have the presigned links and signed attestation, I'll send to FinServe and offer a follow-up call. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Kyle Rivera: Noted. If FinServe asks for raw logs, we'll route through SOC with an NDA and time-limited access. No direct raw exports to prospects.
Alice Chen: Understood. I'll include that in my reply. Will update thread when Legal confirms wording.
risk-bot: auto: comment added to RISK-456 - "Awaiting legal attestation language".
Kyle Rivera: Legal confirmed language at 1748204600: "Redwood Inference attests that the provided redacted penetration test report and vulnerability scan represent findings as of the report dates. No exploit code or customer data is included."
Alice Chen: Sending to FinServe now with presigned links and the attestation. Copying in their vendor-risk contact: @finserve-vendorteam (in external email). Follow-up scheduled Mon if they want deeper review.
Nate Gomez: Final uploads done at 1748204920. Links:
- Pen test (redacted): https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RISK-456/pen-test-redacted.pdf?X
- Scan CSV: https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RISK-456/nessus-export.csv?X
- Remediation matrix: https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RISK-456/remediation-matrix.xlsx?X
Emma Patel: Sent sanitized network diagram and POC checklist as well.
Alice Chen: FinServe replied: "Thanks - reviewing. Can you confirm SLA for patch confirmation once fixes are applied?" I'll loop back here for the exact commitment.
Kyle Rivera: We can offer a post-remediation confirmation within 5 business days after customer requests a re-scan; subject to current support tier. I'll draft the response.
Alice Chen: Thanks all. Closing thread for now - will reopen if they request additional artifacts or a live walkthrough.
